notes: Fixed ARP (Anti-Ransomware Protection) and 8 other fields always showing 'Unknown'/blank for accounts whose full ('TAM') systems query fails and falls back to the reduced 'Efficiency' query tier: isARPEnabled, systemState, lastRebootTime, originalShipDate, marketingType, storageConfiguration, autoUpdateSettings, sustainabilityScores, and vcenters were only ever requested in the full tier, so any account using the fallback tier (a Float-null API quirk unrelated to these fields) never got them at all. Added them to the fallback tier too -- confirmed live: 31 of 167 systems now correctly show ARP enabled where the entire fleet previously showed 'Unknown'. Also fixed the Sustainability Scores panel, which was written for the wrong data shape (expected a flat metric map, API actually returns a dated score-history array) -- now renders a real timeline with actual score/change/factors. Fixed a downtimeEvents shape mismatch (object with totalCount/events, not a bare array) that silently no-opped the Downtime Events line. Note: licenses, pvrs, monthlyCarbonStats, monthlyAutoResolvedCases, and downtimeEvents' event details were found in the same audit but had to be left out of this pass -- adding everything at once exceeded Active IQ's GraphQL query field-count limit and pushed accounts using the fallback tier all the way down to the bare-minimum tier, which is worse. They need to go in as a smaller, separate follow-up.
